13.1 · Andrea Abrams · 7-5-71 · Battersea Pk · 3Sep
Long jumper Andrea Abrams was our only winner but Julia Cockram came close, losing the high jump on count back. Julia went on to compete in four events by the end of the afternoon.

Best events for the seniors were the long and high jumps where the pairings of Andrea Abrams and Syreeta Stracey, and Julia Cockram and Laura Wilson both scored double wins, but the most surprising event was the 400 metre hurdles - when was the last time you saw Gail Richardson line up for the start of such a race?
Andrea Abrams was not far short of her best in winning the long jump and Gail Richardson had a great afternoon with 2nd in the hammer, 2nd in the 'B' hurdles and 1st in the 'B' javelin.
Andrea Abrams continues to dominate our long jump lists and had a best this year of 5.49m. Spear girl Rhiann Letang eyes the 30 metre line before sending down another high scoring throw.

13.1 · Andrea Abrams · 7-5-71 · Battersea Park · 7Sep

Andrea Abrams took charge of the long jump and Natalie Law and Sabrina Scott were unbeaten in both sprints and relays. Try as they could though, the under 15s were unable to come up with any wins this time, and we were 3rd team on the day.
12.9 · Andrea Abrams · 7-5-71 · Portsmouth · 22Aug
In this race Andrea Abrams, now 32, answering a late call-up to help the team out, showed no signs of rustiness and also took second place in the B jump with over 5 metres.
